name: Vollexos
bio: A Magi’s Arcana is unique to every individual, but all manifestations share some common traits – a language, for example, though not one spoken by any people of Amara. To learn it, the Magi forged Vollexos, a Titan of pure knowledge… and it proved to know destruction as much as magic, in the end.
